data.title: Retail Store Fixtures and Mall
data.summary: Apparel and general merchandise shop fixtures, sculpted mannequins, fitting rooms, cash desks, shopfronts and a mall concourse.
data.description: A realistic modern retail fixture library in metre units. Slatwall and gridwall systems and 1.35 m perimeter wall bays, mid-floor hanging rails, nesting tables and a non-grocery gondola, smooth-shaded lofted mannequins and display forms, fitting-room cubicles with named pivoted doors, cash desks on the 600 mm counter grid with a pivoted till drawer, 1.2 m shopfront modules with entrances and roller shutters, and a contemporary mall concourse of unit shells, escalators, balustrades, benches, planters and wayfinding. All signage geometry is blank. Doors, cubicles, counter flaps, lids, lift leaves, the shutter curtain and till drawers each ship a rigid open and close clip on their own pivot, and the spinner rack a turning one: node transforms only, no skinning. CC0 geometry prepared for human review.

usage.blender:
# Blender 4.x: File > Import > glTF 2.0, or from the Python console after downloading the file.
import bpy
bpy.ops.import_scene.gltf(filepath='model.glb')  # from https://cdn.3dassets.dev/assets/25410/v1/model.glb
# Metres and +Y up are converted to Blender's Z-up scene automatically.
usage.godot:
# Godot 4: copy model.glb into res://models/ and the editor imports it as a scene.
var packed := load("res://models/model.glb") as PackedScene
var model := packed.instantiate()
add_child(model)
